_doc: Manifest consumed by scripts/link-config.mjs. Maps an app-template source path (relative to the in-repo submodule root <stack>/.libs/apptemplate) to a project target path (relative to project root). The linker creates a relative symlink target -> submodule source, so it resolves inside the stack's Docker build context. Real files at a target are treated as project-local overrides and left untouched. Sources absent (submodule not initialized) are skipped with a warning. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Entries are added as each mutualization phase lands.
